description: The file is a React component implementing a note-taking application interface, including note listing, editing, searching, and autosave features.

methods.name: formatListDate
methods.description: Formats ISO date strings into a human-readable date string.

methods.name: deriveTitle
methods.description: Derives a note's title based on its content or falls back to default text.

methods.name: normalizeTags
methods.description: Splits, trims, de-duplicates, and normalizes tags from raw input string.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the backend, with optional search query.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with default values and adds it to the list.

methods.name: deleteSelected
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note after confirmation.

methods.name: debouncedAutosave
methods.description: Autosaves the current note after a debounce delay.

methods.name: updateDraftAndAutosave
methods.description: Updates draft state and triggers autosave if applicable.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the current note.
